narrative.details:
Blessings of An'she, friend.

We tauren have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds and I was hoping you'd be interested in honoring this tradition.

You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of Hunter's Rise.

You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.
narrative.objectives: Purchase a Bundle of Herbs from Nida the herbalist, a Bundle of Ceder Twigs from Nata the enchanting supplier, and Sinew Thread from Mahu the leatherworking supplier and Ceremonial Flint and Tinder from Naal the cooking supplier.
narrative.offerRewardText: You have done well.I thank you for taking the time to perform one of our time-honored traditions, friend. I hope that as you travel you will find plenty of occasions you wish to give thanks for.Should you ever wish to perform the ritual again, you should be able to repurchase the components I sent you to collect.Go with An'she's warmth.
narrative.requestItemsText: There are many occasions one may choose to spread incense to the winds. You could be asking the Earthmother to watch over someone, bless a hunt, celebrate an occasion, or even to seek guidance from our ancestors.Or it could be something else entirely.Though the act is done with reverence, it is not strictly a ceremonial affair. Typically there are certain traditional steps observed when performing this act, but many tribes have differing practices.

mentionedItems.name: Prepared Incense
tooltip: Use: Spread the incense over the southern cliff of Hunter Rise.
